The evidence points to a direct interaction between Taxifolin 3-O-beta-D-xylopyranoside and Guanylate cyclase soluble subunit alpha-2, which is then targeted by Colenemol. The integration of these relationships highlights a possible regulatory or enzymatic interaction that could be critical in understanding the pharmacological profile of RXF 631.
